title: A chain build keeps the measurement switches it read at its first step for all its steps
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A build that started with the default split keeps --split-shared for its draft copy after wholeShared went on; a build started after that runs without it.

tests: a build keeps the switches read at its first step: turned on after its plan started, its draft copy still splits
